name: tools.extrabold/gridfinity
title: Extrabold Tools Gridfinity
description: Find drawer presets and create printer-aware Gridfinity baseplate configurations.

tools.name: find_gridfinity_printers
tools.description: Look up a named 3D printer and return exact model IDs and printerBuildVolume for generation tools. Clarify ambiguous model matches with the user; never guess build-volume dimensions.

query.description: Printer model, brand, or exact catalog ID, such as Bambu Lab P2S.

tools.name: find_gridfinity_drawer_presets
tools.description: Find selectable drawer presets and exact Eurobox or KLT model IDs by product name, brand, product line, dimensions or article number. Use the resolved ID with generate_gridfinity_drawer_baseplate; keep user-provided measurements and clarify ambiguous variants.

query.description: Drawer, exact Eurobox, or exact KLT name; brand; product line; article number; dimensions; or other search text.

tools.name: generate_gridfinity_baseplate
tools.description: Configure a Gridfinity baseplate from exact width and depth in millimeters, without a drawer preset. Returns the full-unit grid, leftover margins, printer fit, warnings, a website URL, and an in-chat 3D preview. Supply printerBuildVolume from find_gridfinity_printers to enable automatic splitting.

previewTheme.description: Theme of the fallback preview image. Pass "light" when the chat uses a light theme; defaults to dark.

gridUnitWidth.description: Width of one grid unit in millimeters. Standard Gridfinity uses 42.

gridUnitDepth.description: Depth of one grid unit in millimeters. Standard Gridfinity uses 42.

tolerance.description: Experimental fit setting saved per printer. For dovetails, 0 mm gives the largest male tab; higher values make it smaller, up to 0.5 mm. Also affects CLICKbase clips and magnet holes. Print the tolerance test package to choose a dovetail fit. Normal bin pockets keep fixed geometry; the included bin-fit sample is a reference check. Values: none = 0 mm, tight = 0.1 mm, standard = 0.2 mm, loose = 0.3 mm, very-loose = 0.4 mm, extra-loose = 0.5 mm.

toggleMagnets.description: Add magnet holes to grid unit corners for attaching with magnets

magnetHoleStyle.description: Round holes are sized with the magnet diameter. Crush ribs use a wavy profile with flexible ribs that grip the magnet.

magnetDirection.description: Which side of the baseplate magnets are inserted from.

magnetDiameter.description: Diameter of the magnets in millimeters.

magnetHeight.description: Height or thickness of the magnets in millimeters.

toggleMagnetReleaseHole.description: Add through-holes so magnets can be pushed back out from the opposite side.

toggleScrewHoles.description: Add countersunk screw holes at grid unit intersections for mounting

screwHoleSize.description: Diameter of the screw shaft in millimeters.

screwHeadSize.description: Diameter of the screw head in millimeters.

removeHolesOnSplitLines.description: Remove screw holes that fall on split edges.

marginType.description: Solid: Grid units are placed with margins based on alignment. Margin Fit: Grid units are placed in main grid, and custom-sized connectors fit into margin areas. Half Grid: Half-sized grid units (21 mm for default) fill margins where they fit; the rest stays solid. Use corner alignment (e.g. Top-Left) for larger margins. Overtile: Standard-sized connectors tile across margins, extending beyond baseplate bounds and getting clipped.

borderRadius.description: Radius of the rounded corners for each grid unit

splitToBuildplates.description: Override automatic printer-fit splitting. When omitted with a printer build volume, splitting is enabled only when needed.

splitOffMargins.description: Create outer margins as separate strips while keeping corners attached to top or bottom strips.

plateMarginMm.description: Safety margin applied on each plate edge

splitStrategy.description: Choose how to split the baseplate: Fewer Parts minimizes total pieces, Balanced creates evenly-sized pieces, T-Junctions staggers splits to avoid 4-way crosses for better joint strength

partsConnector.description: Experimental dovetails interlock split pieces without separate parts and use your printer tolerance for male tabs. They require Split to Build Plates and work with all baseplate types. Clips connect split seams and optional outer edges; the printable clip model is included (not compatible with Skeleton).

connectMarginCrossings.description: Also place a dovetail wherever a split edge crosses from grid cells into a margin region. Off: dovetails only at cell-to-cell crossings.

enableEdgeConnectors.description: Add connector clips along the outer perimeter edges of the baseplate

edgeConnectorSides.description: Choose which outer edges receive connector clip holes (back, front, left, right)

linkOrigin.description: Link origin tag added as the org query parameter for attribution.

dimensions.description: Measured interior or desired baseplate width and depth in millimeters.

gridAlignment.description: Alignment of the grid unit grid within the baseplate

tools.name: generate_gridfinity_drawer_baseplate

printerBuildVolume.description: The printer build volume used to decide whether this drawer-sized baseplate must be split.

tools.name: inspect_gridfinity_baseplate
tools.description: Read settings and printer-fit information from an existing full Extrabold Tools Gridfinity baseplate URL using the website decoder. Use this before modifying a link when its settings are unknown. No URL is fetched; custom/sketch and unsupported legacy formats return a clear support status.

url.description: A full HTTPS extrabold.tools or www.extrabold.tools /gridfinity-baseplate link. Short links are not fetched.

tools.name: update_gridfinity_baseplate
tools.description: Return a new URL by changing only explicitly supplied settings in an existing full website configuration link. Nested changes retain unspecified members, attribution, opaque URL parameters, hash, and version. Reuse printerBuildVolume from printer lookup. The original link and user data are unchanged; open the new link on the website to preview and export.

topCutoff.description: Amount to cut off from the top of the baseplate (mm) - applied before splitting to ensure clean edges

printerBuildVolume.description: Partial printer profile. Reuse find_gridfinity_printers results; unspecified dimensions are retained.

changes.description: Only fields the user asked to change. For example {dimensions:{width:252}} retains the existing depth and every other setting.

tools.name: create_gridfinity_baseplate_url
tools.description: Advanced low-level URL composer for a new configuration with exact known website settings. Prefer generation tools for measurements, rows and columns, drawer presets, fit guidance, and previews. Use inspect_gridfinity_baseplate/update_gridfinity_baseplate for existing links; rebuilding them here can discard unspecified settings.
